# Draft:20th Asianet Film Awards

----
The 20th Asianet Film Awards, honoring the best Malayalam films of 2017, was held on May 20, 2018 at Adlux Convention Center, Angamaly. The show was hosted by Jewel Mary and Anjana Unnikrishnan.
